title: Skeleton
description: Quietly pulsing placeholders (`motion-pulse`: 2.5s opacity 1 → 0.6 → 1, stops under prefers-reduced-motion) while content loads, shaped like what loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, SkeletonList (divided list rows), SkeletonTable (table rows), SkeletonDetail (a record's detail panel), PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text or a spinner in a list. BootLoader is the one centred spinner, for the boot / session gate before the shell exists.
when: Any content that is loading: show its shape.
Lists, tables and detail panels: SkeletonList, SkeletonTable, SkeletonDetail (DataTable shows table-shaped rows by itself while loading).
BootLoader: before the app knows its layout (session, auth, boot), once in the root or route-group layout.

instead.need: Loading inside the shell (a page, a tab, a list)
instead.use: Skeleton* or a route loading.tsx with PageSkeleton, never BootLoader

a11y: Loading (and every Skeleton* group) sets role="status" + aria-busy on the container with one screen-reader label; the blocks themselves are aria-hidden.
BootLoader is a role="status" region whose label (default: the locale's booting string) is for screen readers only.

examples.title: List, table and detail
examples.description: Shaped like what loads: avatar rows, a table with a number column, a record with its side panel.

examples.title: Shape of a list page
examples.description: A toolbar row and rows: match what the real page shows. PageSkeleton shape="list" does the same for a whole page.

examples.title: Page shapes (in the shell)
examples.description: cards, list and detail with inShell: what a route loading.tsx renders.

notes: BootLoader waits `delay` (300 ms) before the spinner shows, so a fast check flashes nothing; the spin stops under prefers-reduced-motion. Prefer a server-side session check, which needs no gate (see the App shell doc, "Session gate in the layout").
PageSkeleton takes shape="cards" (default), "list", "detail" or "workspace": pick the one the real page has so nothing jumps when the data arrives.
